entities.summary: Antonio Buero Vallejo was a Spanish playwright associated with the Generation of '36 movement and considered the most important Spanish dramatist of the Spanish Civil War. Antonio Buero Vallejo was a poets & playwrights from Guadalajara (1916-09-29, Guadalajara–2000-04-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
